title: Change Case in CSV – UPPER, lower, Capitalize | OpenAnyDoc
description: Change the text case of a CSV or Excel column in your browser: UPPER, lower or Capitalize Each Word, one column at a time, with Undo. No upload.
heading: Change Case: UPPER, lower or Capitalized
subtitle: Drop a CSV or Excel file and change one column's letter case in a click; nothing is uploaded.
intro: Change text case in a CSV file in your browser: a bar above the table lets you pick a column and turn it into UPPER CASE, lower case or Capitalize Each Word. One column changes at a time, Undo puts it back, and download saves the result. Arabic and other scripts without letter case stay as they are. Excel files open their first sheet. Nothing is uploaded.

features.title: Private
features.text: Your file is opened by your own browser and never sent to a server, so nobody else sees it.

features.title: One column at a time
features.text: Only the column you pick changes, so codes, IDs and other columns stay as they were.

features.title: Works offline
features.text: Once this page has loaded, it keeps working without an internet connection.

stepsTitle: How it works: change text case in a CSV

steps.title: Open your file
steps.text: Drop a CSV or Excel file, choose it, paste CSV into the paste box, or try one of the samples.

steps.title: Pick a column and a case
steps.text: In the bar above the table, choose the column, then UPPER, lower or Capitalize Each Word.

steps.title: Check it
steps.text: The column changes at once. Undo puts it back; repeat for other columns.

steps.title: Download
steps.text: Save the result as CSV, or as Excel, Markdown, HTML or SQL.

handles: Input: CSV files, and Excel .xlsx and .xls files (the first sheet).
Cases: UPPER CASE, lower case and Capitalize Each Word.
Scope: one column at a time.
Scripts without case: Arabic and similar text stays unchanged.
Undo: restores the column as it was.
limits: Excel files: only the first sheet is opened.

faq.question: Is my file uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your browser changes the text on your device; nothing is sent to a server.

faq.question: Which cases can I choose?
faq.answer: UPPER CASE, lower case, and Capitalize Each Word, which turns "sara al-harbi" into "Sara Al-Harbi".

faq.question: Can I change several columns at once?
faq.answer: No, one column at a time. Pick the next column in the bar and apply the case again.

faq.question: What happens to Arabic text?
faq.answer: Nothing. Arabic and other scripts have no capital letters, so their cells stay unchanged; Latin words in the same column still change.

faq.question: Can I undo a change?
faq.answer: Yes. Undo puts the column back as it was.

faq.question: How do I change a column to uppercase in a CSV or Excel file?
faq.answer: Open the file, pick the column, and choose UPPER, lower or Capitalize Each Word; the whole column changes at once. OpenAnyDoc does this in your browser without uploading the file, and you can download the result as CSV or Excel.
